research_question: Where does a giver-reference controller fail when the true object-to-giver translation is unknown, and do calibrated geometry, short observation history or learned residuals improve handover in that regime?

training_support_labels.grasp_5mm: interpolation (x = -5 mm is the support edge)
training_support_labels.grasp_10mm: interpolation in x; z = +-10 mm is the support edge
training_support_labels.grasp_15mm: support corner (x = +15 mm and z = +-10 mm are the training maxima)
training_support_labels.mixed_ood: extrapolation (grasp x down to -7 mm, z to +-15 mm; bias 10 mm, noise 4 mm, delay 4 steps)
training_support_labels.boundary_x_minus_7: extrapolation toward the giver palm (beyond -5 mm)

transitions_per_run.rollout: 1,024 envs x 32 steps = 32,768 per PPO iteration

checkpoint_selection: scripts/v4_select_checkpoints.py: validation mean success (equal weight per condition) desc, unsafe-event rate asc, residual magnitude asc, latest candidate; values rounded to 12 decimals; validation records only
success_definition: V3 evaluator unchanged: the receiver holds the bar independently (giver fingers open, no giver contact, no table support, bar above drop height, low relative speed) for 2.0 s within the 8 s horizon, without a terminal prohibited collision, drop, release timeout or episode timeout
denominator: all scheduled cases; invalid resets count as non-success for every method and are reported separately; systemic reset failures are investigated before any final analysis

primary.inference: paired hierarchical bootstrap over training seeds and base-case clusters (one base-case draw shared across conditions), 10,000 draws, seed 6456401; 95% intervals and Bonferroni 97.5% intervals for the two primary contrasts; deterministic baselines broadcast, never resampled as seeds
primary.degenerate_intervals: a zero-width interval with both arms at 100% (or 0%) is reported as a ceiling (floor) result; no equivalence claim (no equivalence margin is prespecified)

secondary: all other comparisons, conditions and the final-checkpoint sensitivity analysis are exploratory
stopping_rules: no early stopping; every formal run trains for the full budget; a failed run resumes from its latest checkpoint (attempts logged); a run that cannot complete after 3 attempts is reported incomplete, never replaced by another seed

mechanisms.subset: first 5 base cases (by base_case_id) of every final condition = 60 cases
interventions: constant mean residual fitted on development records only

traces.how: separate supplementary batch-6 runs; never replace formal records
